ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَنفَالِ قُلِ ٱلْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا۟ ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (1) They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allāh and the Messenger." So fear Allāh and amend that which is between you and obey Allāh and His Messenger, if you should be believers.
tr: Yasʾalūnaka ʿanil-anfāl, qulil-anfālu lillāhi war-rasūl, fattaqullāha waʾaṣliḥū dhāta baynikum, waʾaṭīʿullāha warasūlahū in kuntum muʾminīn

ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَٰنًا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
en: (2) The believers are only those who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely -
tr: Innamal-muʾminūnal-ladhīna idhā dhukirallāhu wajilat qulūbuhum waʾidhā tuliyat ʿalayhim āyātuhū zādathum īmānaw waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
en: (3) The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
tr: Al-ladhīna yuqīmūnaṣ-ṣalāta wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَّهُمْ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: (4) Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.
tr: Ulāʾika humul-muʾminūna ḥaqqā, lahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfiratuw warizqun karīm

ar: كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَٰرِهُونَ
en: (5) [It[437] is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,
enNotes: [437]- Referring to a dispute which occurred among the Muslims over distribution of war booty.
tr: Kamā akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bil-ḥaqq, waʾinna farīqam minal-muʾminīna lakārihūn

ar: يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ فِى ٱلْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
en: (6) Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.
tr: Yujādilūnaka fil-ḥaqqi baʿda mā tabayyana kaʾannamā yusāqūna ilal-mawti wahum yanẓurūn

ar: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (7) [Remember, O believers], when Allāh promised you one of the two groups[438] - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allāh intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers
enNotes: [438]- i.e., either the caravan of Quraysh or their army.
tr: Waʾidh yaʿidukumullāhu iḥdaṭ-ṭāʾifatayni annahā lakum watawaddūna anna ghayra dhātish-shawkati takūnu lakum wayurīdullāhu ay yuḥiqqal-ḥaqqa bikalimātihī wayaqṭaʿa dābiral-kāfirīn

ar: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
en: (8) That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
tr: Liyuḥiqqal-ḥaqqa wayubṭilal-bāṭila walaw karihal-mujrimūn

ar: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
en: (9) [Remember] when you were asking help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."
tr: Idh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fastajāba lakum annī mumiddukum biʾalfim minal-malāʾikati murdifīn

ar: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: (10) And Allāh made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Wamā jaʿalahullāhu illā bushrā walitaṭmaʾinna bihī qulūbukum, waman-naṣru illā min ʿindillāh, innallāha ʿazīzun ḥakīm

ar: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِّنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِۦ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمْ رِجْزَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلْأَقْدَامَ
en: (11) [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.
tr: Idh yughashshīkumun-nuʿāsa amanatam minhu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum minas-samāʾi māʾal liyuṭahhirakum bihī wayudhhiba ʿankum rijzash-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihil-aqdām

ar: إِذْ يُوحِى رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّى مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ سَأُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَٱضْرِبُوا۟ فَوْقَ ٱلْأَعْنَاقِ وَٱضْرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ
en: (12) [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."[439]
enNotes: [439]- By which they grasp and manipulate their weapons. Also interpreted as "all extremities," i.e., their hands and feet.
tr: Idh yūḥī rabbuka ilal-malāʾikati annī maʿakum fathabbitul-ladhīna āmanū, saʾulqī fī qulūbil-ladhīna kafarur-ruʿba faḍribū fawqal-aʿnāqi waḍribū minhum kulla banān

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
en: (13) That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh and His Messenger - indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
tr: Dhālika biʾannahum shāqqullāha warasūlah, wamay yushāqiqillāha warasūlahū faʾinnallāha shadīdul-ʿiqāb

ar: ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (14) "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.
tr: Dhālikum fadhūqūhu waʾanna lil-kāfirīna ʿadhāban-nār

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ
en: (15) O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū idhā laqītumul-ladhīna kafarū zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumul-adbār

ar: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُۥٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (16) And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allāh, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination.
tr: Wamay yuwallihim yawmaʾidhin duburahū illā mutaḥarrifal liqitālin aw mutaḥayyizan ilā fiʾatin faqad bāʾa bighaḍabim minallāhi wamaʾwāhu jahannam, wabiʾsal-maṣīr

ar: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ وَلِيُبْلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (17) And you did not kill them, but it was Allāh who killed them.[440] And you threw not, [O Muḥammad], when you threw, but it was Allāh who threw[441] that He might test the believers with a good test.[442] Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
enNotes:
[440]- i.e., Your strength was insufficient to overcome them, but Allāh supported you and gave you victory.
[441]- When the Prophet (ﷺ) threw a handful of dust into the faces of the disbelievers, Allāh caused it to fill the eyes and nose of every soldier, preventing their advance.
[442]- So that they would appreciate Allāh's favor to them.
tr: Falam taqtulūhum walākinnallāha qatalahum, wamā ramayta idh ramayta walākinnallāha ramā, waliyubliyal-muʾminīna minhu balāʾan ḥasanā, innallāha samīʿun ʿalīm

ar: ذَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (18) That [is so], and [also] that Allāh will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.
tr: Dhālikum waʾannallāha mūhinu kaydil-kāfirīn

ar: إِن تَسْتَفْتِحُوا۟ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْفَتْحُ وَإِن تَنتَهُوا۟ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَإِن تَعُودُوا۟ نَعُدْ وَلَن تُغْنِىَ عَنكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (19) If you [disbelievers] seek the decision [i.e., victory] - the decision [i.e., defeat] has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allāh is with the believers.
tr: In tastaftiḥū faqad jāʾakumul-fatḥ, waʾin tantahū fahuwa khayrul lakum, waʾin taʿūdū naʿud, walan tughniya ʿankum fiʾatukum shayʾaw walaw kathurat waʾannallāha maʿal-muʾminīn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
en: (20) O you who have believed, obey Allāh and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū aṭīʿullāha warasūlahū walā tawallaw ʿanhu waʾantum tasmaʿūn

ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
en: (21) And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear.
tr: Walā takūnū kal-ladhīna qālū samiʿnā wahum lā yasmaʿūn

ar: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلْبُكْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
en: (22) Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].
tr: Inna sharrad-dawābbi ʿindallāhiṣ-ṣummul-bukmul-ladhīna lā yaʿqilūn

ar: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: (23) Had Allāh known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.
tr: Walaw ʿalimallāhu fīhim khayral laʾasmaʿahum, walaw asmaʿahum latawallaw wahum muʿriḍūn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَأَنَّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
en: (24) O you who have believed, respond to Allāh and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allāh intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanustajībū lillāhi walir-rasūli idhā daʿākum limā yuḥyīkum, waʿlamū annallāha yaḥūlu baynal-marʾi waqalbihī waʾannahū ilayhi tuḥsharūn

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
en: (25) And fear a trial[443] which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allāh is severe in penalty.
enNotes: [443]- i.e., an affliction or punishment during life upon this earth. When corruption spreads among a people, its consequences will affect everyone.
tr: Wattaqū fitnatal lā tuṣībannal-ladhīna ẓalamū minkum khāṣṣah, waʿlamū annallāha shadīdul-ʿiqāb

ar: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (26) And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.
tr: Wadhkurū idh antum qalīlum mustaḍʿafūna fil-arḍi takhāfūna ay yatakhaṭṭafakumun-nāsu faʾāwākum waʾayyadakum binaṣrihī warazaqakum minaṭ-ṭayyibāti laʿallakum tashkurūn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَخُونُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوٓا۟ أَمَٰنَٰتِكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (27) O you who have believed, do not betray Allāh and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence].
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā takhūnullāha war-rasūla watakhūnū amānātikum waʾantum taʿlamūn

ar: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (28) And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allāh has with Him a great reward.
tr: Waʿlamū annamā amwālukum waʾawlādukum fitnatuw waʾannallāha ʿindahū ajrun ʿaẓīm

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: (29) O you who have believed, if you fear Allāh, He will grant you a criterion[444] and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
enNotes: [444]- By which to judge between truth and falsehood. Also interpreted as a "way out" of difficulties.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū in tattaqullāha yajʿal lakum furqānaw wayukaffir ʿankum sayyiʾātikum wayaghfir lakum, wallāhu dhul-faḍlil-ʿaẓīm

ar: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ
en: (30) And [remember, O Muḥammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allāh plans. And Allāh is the best of planners.
tr: Waʾidh yamkuru bikal-ladhīna kafarū liyuthbitūka aw yaqtulūka aw yukhrijūk, wayamkurūna wayamkurullāh, wallāhu khayrul-mākirīn

ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالُوا۟ قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَٰذَآ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (31) And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
tr: Waʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā qālū qad samiʿnā law nashāʾu laqulnā mithla hādhā in hādhā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn

ar: وَإِذْ قَالُوا۟ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَوِ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (32) And [remember] when they said, "O Allāh, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."
tr: Waʾidh qālullāhumma in kāna hādhā huwal-ḥaqqa min ʿindika faʾamṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratam minas-samāʾi awiʾtinā biʿadhābin alīm

ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
en: (33) But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.
tr: Wamā kānallāhu liyuʿadhdhibahum waʾanta fīhim, wamā kānallāhu muʿadhdhibahum wahum yastaghfirūn

ar: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآءَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (34) But why should Allāh not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.
tr: Wamā lahum allā yuʿadhdhibahumullāhu wahum yaṣuddūna ʿanil-masjidil-ḥarāmi wamā kānū awliyāʾah, in awliyāʾuhū illal-muttaqūna walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَآءً وَتَصْدِيَةً فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
en: (35) And their prayer at the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved [i.e., practiced of deviations].
tr: Wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿindal-bayti illā mukāʾaw wataṣdiyah, fadhūqul-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ
en: (36) Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allāh. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered.
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū yunfiqūna amwālahum liyaṣuddū ʿan sabīlillāh, fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasratan thumma yughlabūn, wal-ladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama yuḥsharūn

ar: لِيَمِيزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُۥ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُۥ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُۥ فِى جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
en: (37) [It is] so that Allāh may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers.
tr: Liyamīzallāhul-khabītha minaṭ-ṭayyibi wayajʿalal-khabītha baʿḍahū ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahū jamīʿan fayajʿalahū fī jahannam, ulāʾika humul-khāsirūn

ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَنتَهُوا۟ يُغْفَرْ لَهُم مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُوا۟ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (38) Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.[445]
enNotes: [445]- This is a warning that punishment is always the result of rebellion against Allāh and His messengers.
tr: Qul lilladhīna kafarū iy yantahū yughfar lahum mā qad salaf, waʾiy yaʿūdū faqad maḍat sunnatul-awwalīn

ar: وَقَٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ كُلُّهُۥ لِلَّهِ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (39) And fight against them until there is no fitnah[446] and [until] the religion [i.e., worship], all of it, is for Allāh.[447] And if they cease - then indeed, Allāh is Seeing of what they do.
enNotes:
[446]- Persecution. See footnote to 2:191.
[447]- i.e., until polytheism is no longer dominant.
tr: Waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fitnatuw wayakūnad-dīnu kulluhū lillāh, faʾinintahaw faʾinnallāha bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
en: (40) But if they turn away - then know that Allāh is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
tr: Waʾin tawallaw faʿlamū annallāha mawlākum, niʿmal-mawlā waniʿman-naṣīr

ar: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُۥ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (41) And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allāh is one fifth of it and for the Messenger[448] and for [his] near relatives[449] and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler,[450] if you have believed in Allāh and in that which We sent down to Our Servant[451] on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allāh, over all things, is competent.
enNotes:
[448]- To be spent in Allāh's cause.
[449]- The tribes of Banū Hāshim and Banū Muṭṭalib, who were not eligible for zakāh.
[450]- The remaining four fifths are divided among the soldiers.
[451]- Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).
tr: Waʿlamū annamā ghanimtum min shayʾin faʾanna lillāhi khumusahū walir-rasūli walidhil-qurbā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wabnis-sabīli in kuntum āmantum billāhi wamā anzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawmal-furqāni yawmal-taqal-jamʿān, wallāhu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: إِذْ أَنتُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلْقُصْوَىٰ وَٱلرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْمِيعَٰدِ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَىَّ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (42) [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
tr: Idh antum bil-ʿudwatid-dunyā wahum bil-ʿudwatil-quṣwā war-rakbu asfala minkum, walaw tawāʿattum lakhtalaftum fil-mīʿādi walākil liyaqḍiyallāhu amran kāna mafʿūlal liyahlika man halaka ʿam bayyinatiw wayaḥyā man ḥayya ʿam bayyinah, waʾinnallāha lasamīʿun ʿalīm

ar: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا وَلَوْ أَرَىٰكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَلَّمَ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: (43) [Remember, O Muḥammad], when Allāh showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allāh saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Idh yurīkahumullāhu fī manāmika qalīlā, walaw arākahum kathīral lafashiltum walatanāzaʿtum fil-amri walākinnallāha sallam, innahū ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ ٱلْتَقَيْتُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
en: (44) And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allāh are [all] matters returned.
tr: Waʾidh yurīkumūhum idhil-taqaytum fī aʿyunikum qalīlaw wayuqallilukum fī aʿyunihim liyaqḍiyallāhu amran kāna mafʿūlā, waʾilallāhi turjaʿul-umūr

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَٱثْبُتُوا۟ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
en: (45) O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allāh much that you may be successful.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū idhā laqītum fiʾatan fathbutū wadhkurullāha kathīral laʿallakum tufliḥūn

ar: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَنَٰزَعُوا۟ فَتَفْشَلُوا۟ وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
en: (46) And obey Allāh and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.
tr: Waʾaṭīʿullāha warasūlahū walā tanāzaʿū fatafshalū watadhhaba rīḥukum waṣbirū, innallāha maʿaṣ-ṣābirīn

ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بَطَرًا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
en: (47) And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allāh. And Allāh is encompassing[452] of what they do.
tr: Walā takūnū kal-ladhīna kharajū min diyārihim baṭaraw wariʾāʾan-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīlillāh, wallāhu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭ

ar: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَإِنِّى جَارٌ لَّكُمْ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ ٱلْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
en: (48) And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allāh. And Allāh is severe in penalty."
tr: Waʾidh zayyana lahumush-shayṭānu aʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumul-yawma minan-nāsi waʾinnī jārul lakum, falammā tarāʾatil-fiʾatāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla innī barīʾum minkum innī arā mā lā tarawna innī akhāfullāh, wallāhu shadīdul-ʿiqāb

ar: إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِينُهُمْ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: (49) [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease [i.e., arrogance and disbelief] said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Idh yaqūlul-munāfiqūna wal-ladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun gharra hāʾulāʾi dīnuhum, wamay yatawakkal ʿalallāhi faʾinnallāha ʿazīzun ḥakīm

ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
en: (50) And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved...[453] They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.
enNotes: [453]- This sentence is left incomplete for additional effect. Its conclusion is left to the imagination of the reader or listener and estimated as "...you would see a dreadful sight."
tr: Walaw tarā idh yatawaffal-ladhīna kafarul-malāʾikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum waʾadbārahum, wadhūqū ʿadhābal-ḥarīq

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
en: (51) That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
tr: Dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum waʾannallāha laysa biẓallāmil lil-ʿabīd

ar: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
en: (52) [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allāh, so Allāh seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and severe in penalty.
tr: Kadaʾbi āli firʿawna wal-ladhīna min qablihim, kafarū biʾāyātillāhi faʾakhadhahumullāhu bidhunūbihim, innallāha qawiyyun shadīdul-ʿiqāb

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (53) That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
tr: Dhālika biʾannallāha lam yaku mughayyiran niʿmatan anʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā biʾanfusihim waʾannallāha samīʿun ʿalīm

ar: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
en: (54) [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers.
tr: Kadaʾbi āli firʿawna wal-ladhīna min qablihim, kadhdhabū biʾāyāti rabbihim faʾahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim waʾaghraqnā āla firʿawn, wakullun kānū ẓālimīn

ar: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (55) Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe-
tr: Inna sharrad-dawābbi ʿindallāhil-ladhīna kafarū fahum lā yuʾminūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِى كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ
en: (56) The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allāh.
tr: Al-ladhīna ʿāhatta minhum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fī kulli marratiw wahum lā yattaqūn

ar: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
en: (57) So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.[454]
enNotes: [454]- i.e., kill them and make an example of them to discourage those who follow them.
tr: Faʾimmā tathqafannahum fil-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laʿallahum yadhdhakkarūn

ar: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَٱنۢبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
en: (58) If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms.[455] Indeed, Allāh does not like traitors.
enNotes: [455]- When you see signs of treachery from those with whom you have made a treaty, announce to them its dissolution so they will know exactly where they stand.
tr: Waʾimmā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānatan fambidh ilayhim ʿalā sawāʾ, innallāha lā yuḥibbul-khāʾinīn

ar: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَبَقُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ
en: (59) And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allāh].
tr: Walā yaḥsabannal-ladhīna kafarū sabaqū, innahum lā yuʿjizūn

ar: وَأَعِدُّوا۟ لَهُم مَّا ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ ٱلْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِۦ عَدُوَّ ٱللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
en: (60) And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war[456] by which you may terrify the enemy of Allāh and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allāh knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allāh will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.
enNotes: [456]- Or equipment which serves the same purpose.
tr: Waʾaʿiddū lahum mastaṭaʿtum min quwwatiw wamir ribāṭil-khayli turhibūna bihī ʿaduwwallāhi waʿaduwwakum waʾākharīna min dūnihim, lā taʿlamūnahum, allāhu yaʿlamuhum, wamā tunfiqū min shayʾin fī sabīlillāhi yuwaffa ilaykum waʾantum lā tuẓlamūn

ar: وَإِن جَنَحُوا۟ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (61) And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Waʾin janaḥū lis-salmi fajnaḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalallāh, innahū huwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ ٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَبِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (62) But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allāh. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers
tr: Waʾiy yurīdū ay yakhdaʿūka faʾinna ḥasbakallāh, huwal-ladhī ayyadaka binaṣrihī wabil-muʾminīn

ar: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّآ أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: (63) And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allāh brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Waʾallafa bayna qulūbihim, law anfaqta mā fil-arḍi jamīʿam mā allafta bayna qulūbihim walākinnallāha allafa baynahum, innahū ʿazīzun ḥakīm

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَسْبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (64) O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu ḥasbukallāhu wamanittabaʿaka minal-muʾminīn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
en: (65) O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are steadfast], they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand.
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu ḥarriḍil-muʾminīna ʿalal-qitāl, iy yakum minkum ʿishrūna ṣābirūna yaghlibū miʾatayn, waʾiy yakum minkum miʾatuy yaghlibū alfam minal-ladhīna kafarū biʾannahum qawmul lā yafqahūn

ar: ٱلْـَٰٔنَ خَفَّفَ ٱللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
en: (66) Now, Allāh has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the steadfast.
tr: Al-āna khaffafallāhu ʿankum waʿalima anna fīkum ḍaʿfā, faʾiy yakum minkum miʾatun ṣābiratuy yaghlibū miʾatayn, waʾiy yakum minkum alfuy yaghlibū alfayni biʾidhnillāh, wallāhu maʿaṣ-ṣābirīn

ar: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: (67) It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allāh's enemies] in the land. You [i.e., some Muslims] desire the commodities of this world,[457] but Allāh desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
enNotes: [457]- i.e., material benefit, such as the ransom paid for prisoners.
tr: Mā kāna linabiyyin ay yakūna lahū asrā ḥattā yuthkhina fil-arḍ, turīdūna ʿaraḍad-dunyā, wallāhu yurīdul-ākhirah, wallāhu ʿazīzun ḥakīm

ar: لَّوْلَا كِتَٰبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَآ أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (68) If not for a decree from Allāh that preceded,[458] you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment.
enNotes: [458]- Three interpretations of the "decree" are given: that by which the companions of Badr were forgiven, that by which indeliberate errors in judgement by believers are not punished, and that which made lawful the spoils of war.
tr: Lawlā kitābum minallāhi sabaqa lamassakum fīmā akhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm

ar: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (69) So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Fakulū mimmā ghanimtum ḥalālan ṭayyibā, wattaqullāh, innallāha ghafūrur raḥīm

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّمَن فِىٓ أَيْدِيكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَسْرَىٰٓ إِن يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّآ أُخِذَ مِنكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (70) O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allāh knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul liman fī aydīkum minal-asrā iy yaʿlamillāhu fī qulūbikum khayray yuʾtikum khayram mimmā ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum, wallāhu ghafūrur raḥīm

ar: وَإِن يُرِيدُوا۟ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: (71) But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allāh before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Waʾiy yurīdū khiyānataka faqad khānullāha min qablu faʾamkana minhum wallāhu ʿalīmun ḥakīm

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَٰيَتِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ وَإِنِ ٱسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (72) Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū biʾamwālihim waʾanfusihim fī sabīlillāhi wal-ladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāʾika baʿḍuhum awliyāʾu baʿḍ, wal-ladhīna āmanū walam yuhājirū mā lakum miw walāyatihim min shayʾin ḥattā yuhājirū, waʾinistanṣarūkum fid-dīni faʿalaykumun-naṣru illā ʿalā qawmim baynakum wabaynahum mīthāq, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ
en: (73) And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.
tr: Wal-ladhīna kafarū baʿḍuhum awliyāʾu baʿḍ, illā tafʿalūhu takun fitnatun fil-arḍi wafasādun kabīr

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: (74) But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīlillāhi wal-ladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāʾika humul-muʾminūna ḥaqqā, lahum maghfiratuw warizqun karīm

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ مَعَكُمْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
en: (75) And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh.[459] Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.
enNotes: [459]- This applies to Muslim relatives only. Others may be given by bequest. See 4:11.
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū mim baʿdu wahājarū wajāhadū maʿakum faʾulāʾika minkum, waʾulul-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābillāh, innallāha bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
